text: Among those, Earth is characterized by fragrance. It is of two kinds: eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is in the form of an atom; the non-eternal is in the form of an effect. The latter is further divided into three types based on the distinction between the body, the sense organ, and the object: the body is that of ourselves and others; the sense organ is the olfactory organ that perceives fragrance, located at the tip of the nose; and the object is soil, stone, and so on.
